csv_project_name: Design for Poindexter Village African American Museum
csv_scope_of_work: Ohio History Connection (OHC) invites proposals for the design, fabrication, and installation of a roughly 2800 square foot exhibit at the Poindexter Village African American Museum. OHC and James Preston Poindexter Foundation (JPPF) have partnered to save two buildings from the 1940 Poindexter Village public housing development in Columbus, Ohio. Plans are underway to convert these buildings into a museum. The project includes construction of a visitor center that will link the two currently separate, but neighboring, structures.
